items.text: the bar's Input button wears the ring: it opens the rings, Input first
Fade in the Color ring: how long a color you pick takes to blend in, from a jump to six seconds; it replaces "mine" (your colors stay in the Color panel)
on the iPad home screen, an open shelf reaches the bottom edge of the screen
the preview carries the live fixes for coming back to the app
coming back from another app, the bar and its shelf lay themselves out again for the screen they are on
three fingers hide the controls only on a quick tap, never when the iPad's app-switch gesture passes through
the preview carries the live Pack and Water fix
opening the water from Pack keeps Pack beside it as a tab, so there is a way back; the sound panel shows Pack too
Water is listed once, under Playing now; the library lists only what you can add
the preview carries the live fix for the switch's ends
the sound shelf's Beats · Field · Touch switch keeps its round ends when an end is lit
the preview carries the live fixes (FEME Starter, glass swept from shelves) under tonight's work
